lines.zh: 发出低沉的嘶嘶声，向前移动。
lines.en: Makes a low hiss and moves forward.

lines.zh: 根茎从土壤中探出，紧紧抓住。
lines.en: Roots poke out of the ground and grip tight.
Body twists to move towards the player.
Makes stifled moans continuously.

lines.zh: 藤蔓缠绕自身，缓慢移动。
lines.en: Wraps itself in vines and moves slowly.

lines.zh: 枝条伸向玩家，试图缠住。
lines.en: Branches reach out to grab the player.

lines.zh: 试图攀爬玩家，却被推开。
lines.en: Attempts to climb the player, but is pushed away.

lines.zh: 根系快速生长，逼近玩家。
lines.en: Roots grow quickly and approach the player.

lines.zh: 触须在空中摇摆，寻找目标。
lines.en: 触须在空中摇摆，寻找目标. Tendrils sway in the air, searching for a target.

lines.zh: 藤蔓突然缩短，迅速靠近。
lines.en: Vines suddenly shorten and move closer quickly.

lines.zh: 根须在土里一收一放，往前爬。
lines.en: My roots clench and release, pulling me forward.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑，像长出来的一条藤。
lines.en: I slide low like a vine that just grew.
Stands quietly, waiting.

lines.zh: 根茎缓慢摆动，似乎在思考。
lines.en: Roots move slowly, as if thinking.

lines.zh: 藤蔓轻轻摆动，似乎在呼吸。
lines.en: Vines move gently, as if breathing.
Tendrils stretch out, exploring.

lines.zh: 根系轻轻抖动，发出细微声响。
lines.en: Roots shake slightly, making a faint noise.

lines.zh: 茎干轻轻颤动，显得不安。
lines.en: Stalk trembles lightly, appearing uneasy.

lines.zh: 藤蔓偶尔移动，似乎在寻找。
lines.en: Vines move occasionally, as if searching.
Branches bend, as if listening.
Tendrils gently touch, probing.

lines.zh: 藤蔓缓缓摆动，寻找线索。
lines.en: Vines slowly sway, seeking clues.

lines.zh: 我的菌盖往下滴着腐水。
lines.en: Rot drips from beneath my fungal cap.

lines.zh: 我挂在菌盖上，一动不动。
lines.en: I hang from a fungal cap without moving.

lines.zh: 一根须探出来，又缩回去。
lines.en: One tendril reaches out and withdraws.

lines.zh: 腐化真菌的气味裹着我。
lines.en: The smell of corrupted fungus wraps around me.

lines.zh: 我在土里憋着，等脚步声。
lines.en: I hold in the soil, listening for footsteps.
My folds pulse as if breathing.
Hyphae wind around my joints.

lines.zh: 我半埋在腐土里，装成一堆菌。
lines.en: Half buried in rot, I pass for a heap of fungus.
Hisses when it spots the player.
Stares at the player, vines tighten.

lines.zh: 向玩家方向转动，触须伸展。
lines.en: Turns towards the player, tendrils extend.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，试图吸引注意。
lines.en: Stares at the player, trying to draw attention.
Locks onto the player, roots taut.

lines.zh: 腐化真菌里，我贴着地爬。
lines.en: In the corrupted fungus, I crawl low.

lines.zh: 向玩家方向旋转，触须探出。
lines.en: Rotates towards the player, tendrils extending.
Takes notice of the player, vines tighten.
Stares intently at the player, trying to grab.

lines.zh: 确定玩家位置，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Hisses when it locates the player.

lines.zh: 我抬起那张皱巴巴的脸。
lines.en: I lift that shriveled face.
The eye-spots under my cap turn to you.
I recognize the twig you snapped.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，我记在菌丝里。
lines.en: I keep the sound of your steps in my hyphae.

lines.zh: 我从菌丛里探出半截看你。
lines.en: I poke half of myself out of the fungus to look.
Corrupted Mind wails in pain
I'm corrupted...
I was pure...
I shouldn't exist...

lines.zh: 求你救我，我的脑壳爬在地上。
lines.en: Save me; my skull is crawling on the ground.
My soul burns...
I want to live...
I crave freedom...
Please spare me...
I... I wasn't like this...

lines.zh: 你手中的果实让我垂涎三尺！
lines.en: The fruit in your hand tempts me!

lines.zh: 别想逃跑，我会咬住你不放！
lines.en: Don't try to run, I'll hold you!

lines.zh: 腐化之果是我们的美食！
lines.en: Corrupted fruits are our delicacy!
This land nourishes me!

lines.zh: 腐化之脑渴望吞噬你的智慧！
lines.en: Corrupted Mind craves your wisdom!
Your skin hides the deliciousness!

lines.zh: 触感是腐化之地的馈赠！
lines.en: Touch is a gift from corruption!

lines.zh: 你身上的腐化之气引诱我！
lines.en: The corruption on you tempts me!
The source of corruption feeds me!

lines.zh: 腐化之地的果实滋养我！
lines.en: Fruits from corruption nourish me!
I'm here, you can't avoid me!

lines.zh: 我贴着地面追，绕不过就爬。
lines.en: I chase along the ground; if I cannot go around, I climb.
Your body blocks me!
Collisions bring me closer!

lines.zh: 腐化的菌地上，我爬得很快。
lines.en: On corrupted mycelium I crawl fast.
We must collide!
You block my way!
Collisions bring me closer!

lines.zh: 菌丝铺的路，被我踩断了。
lines.en: The mycelium road snapped under my feet.
I must collide with you!
Finding a mate is important!

lines.zh: 我的孢子只认这一种菌丝。
lines.en: My spores know only this one mycelium.
Find a suitable mate!

lines.zh: 菌丝缠上我的脚，我在找同类。
lines.en: Mycelium wraps my feet; I seek my own kind.
We need each other!
Find a good mate!

lines.zh: 腐化菌林里，我想听见回应。
lines.en: In the corrupted grove, I long for an answer.
We should rely on each other!
I need to find a good mate!
Find a partner together!

lines.zh: 腐化之脑正在啃食腐化真菌。
lines.en: Corrupted Mind chomps on corrupted fungus.
Its sticky tendrils resemble ink.

lines.zh: 它似乎对腐化真菌情有独钟。
lines.en: It has a special affinity for corrupted fungi.

lines.zh: 它从腐化真菌中获取养分。
lines.en: It feeds on the corrupted fungi.

lines.zh: 腐化之脑正在消化腐化真菌。
lines.en: Corrupted Mind digests the corrupted fungus.

lines.zh: 腐化之脑粘附在腐化真菌上。
lines.en: Corrupted Mind clings to the corrupted fungus.

lines.zh: 腐化之脑在寻找腐化真菌。
lines.en: Corrupted Mind seeks out corrupted fungi.

lines.zh: 腐化之脑吸收腐化真菌的能量。
lines.en: Corrupted Mind absorbs energy from the corrupted fungus.

lines.zh: 腐化之脑正在吞食腐化真菌。
lines.en: Corrupted Mind gulps down corrupted fungi.
It relies on corrupted fungi for survival.

lines.zh: 腐化之脑注意到了玩家。
lines.en: Corrupted Mind spots the player.

lines.zh: 我从腐化菌毯里长出来。
lines.en: I grow up out of the corrupted mycelium.
Corrupted Mind locks onto the target.
It targets the player.
Corrupted Mind starts chasing.
It approaches the player.
Corrupted Mind locks onto prey.
It attacks the player.
Corrupted Mind moves closer to the player.
Corrupted Mind chases the player.
Corrupted Mind bites the player.
It teleports closer to the player.
Corrupted Mind climbs the player.
It doesn't let go.
Corrupted Mind chases and bites the player.
It wraps tendrils around the player.
Corrupted Mind ensnares the player.
It doesn't release the player.

lines.zh: 腐化之脑紧紧咬住玩家。
lines.en: Corrupted Mind clamps down on the player.
It holds on tightly.

lines.zh: 你躲在够不着的地方，我瞬移过去。
lines.en: Hide where I cannot reach, and I blink across.

lines.zh: 我缠住你的脚，往土里拖。
lines.en: I coil round your foot and drag you into soil.
Chomp at your throat!
Wrap my roots around you!
Drain your life!
Rip you to shreds!
Chomp your arm!
Savor your blood!
Pierce your skin with thorns!
Inhale your heart!
Wrap my tendrils around you!
Taste this delicious prey!
Spawn from corrupted fungi!
Roam in the darkness!
Corruption is our fate!
Corruption, everywhere!
Coexist with corruption!
Corrupted Mind, never fades!
Corrupted tendrils reach you!

lines.zh: 腐化之地，我唯一的归宿！
lines.en: Corrupted land, my only home!
Corruption, consume all!

lines.zh: 腐化真菌间，我拱破土层。
lines.en: Among corrupted fungus, I break through the soil.
Spores burst, and I drop to the ground.

lines.zh: 菌丝从四面八方汇到我身上。
lines.en: Hyphae gather into me from every side.
The rot turns over, and my skull rises.
In this fungal wood, there is only me.
Flames scorch my tendrils
Corrupted Mind falls to the ground
Corrupted Mind sinks into water
Explosion rips through my body
Arrow pierces my body
Magic tears at my soul
Hunger drains my strength
Lightning strikes my tendrils

lines.zh: 脚下的菌毯没了，我往下掉。
lines.en: The fungal carpet vanishes; I fall.
